summary: Quincy should retain a true standalone municipal control row. Official Quincy Police Department materials show an active city police department with its own command structure and annual reporting, and the agency-to-jurisdiction crosswalk for IL0010300 is an exclusive Quincy city match. The current all-fill state is not county replacement or target invalidity; it is a post-2021 reporting/publication and repo-ingestion continuity failure likely compounded by the city's May 2022 cyber incident. The official Quincy Police Department 2024 annual report is production-usable for backfill and reports 2024 Quincy counts of robbery 4, aggravated assault/battery 28, burglary 61, theft 141, motor vehicle theft 126, and criminal sexual assault 46.
